entities.name: Clementina Maude, Viscountess Hawarden
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Clementina Maude, Viscountess Hawarden, commonly known as Lady Clementina Hawarden, was a Scottish amateur portrait photographer of the Victorian era. She produced over 800 photographs mostly of her adolescent daughters.
